items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: They tore that down a couple of years ago, I think. She was tearing it down. But, anyway, he had the session on Sunday afternoon. Manhattan Towers. I don't know the name of it but they had Leonard Feather ... was giving the sessions.

ctx.x: How did Duke Ellington's band compare to, say, the Cotton Pickers in popularity?
I don't like to talk about those things.
I mean as far as the general public was concerned.
